description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'CommonCredential' in the 'org.eclipse.hono.service.management.credentials' package. The class encapsulates common properties and behaviors related to credentials in the Hono project, including fields for authentication ID, enabled status, comments, and extensions, along with getter, setter, and validation methods.

classes.name: CommonCredential
classes.description: An abstract class representing common credential information, supporting various credential types within the Hono system.

methods.name: getSecrets
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve a list of secrets associated with the credential.

methods.name: getAuthId
methods.description: Returns the authentication identifier used for device authentication.

methods.name: setAuthId
methods.description: Sets the authentication identifier used for device authentication and returns the credential object for fluent chaining.

methods.name: getEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the credential is enabled for use.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Sets the enabled status of the credential and returns the credential object for fluent chaining.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the human-readable comment describing the credential.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets a human-readable comment for the credential and returns the credential object for fluent chaining.

methods.name: getExtensions
methods.description: Returns the map of extension properties associated with the credential.

methods.name: setExtensions
methods.description: Sets the extension properties for the credential and returns the credential object for fluent chaining.

methods.name: putExtension
methods.description: Adds or replaces an extension property key-value pair, returning the credential object for fluent chaining.

methods.name: checkValidity
methods.description: Validates that the credential has a non-null, non-empty authentication ID, throwing an exception if invalid.
